# centralDogma07

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

You can find this package on GitHub: https://github.com/rforbiodatascience26/group_7_package 

This package is an implementation of the central dogma of biology. A sequence of a specified length can be created. It can then be translated and transcribed. The amino acid composition can then be plotted.

### Functions
- creating_dna(): create a DNA sequence of the specified length

- to_rna(): translates a DNA sequence into its corresponding RNA sequence

- separate_codons(): cuts a sequence into codons of length 3. Default option is to start at the first nucleotide. Specify start parameter to start separating at a different place in the sequence.

- function_4(): translates a list of codons into a sequences of amino acids

- plot_aa_composition(): plots the aa composition of a sequence.

### This package as a whole
A dna sequence of a specified length can be created using the creating_dna().
This sequence can then be tranlated to RNA using the function to_rna().
The RNA sequence is then split into codons of 3 nuclotides by using the function separate_codons(). 
Codons are then transcribed to amino acids, using the function function_4(). 
The aa composition can then be ploted using the plot_aa_composition() function.
